cohort: The cohort consisted of 444 Swedish women, identified from the Swedish Medical Birth Register based on their 2005 pregnancies, including those with GDM and those with uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Four years postpartum, all 19 participants who developed overt diabetes had a history of GDM, and while lifestyle differences between groups were not major at follow-up, women with previous GDM were significantly older and reported higher body weight and less PA before the index pregnancy.
followup_time: approximately four years after the pregnancy
